subject: MPA: Final security acceptance & retention decisions (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@opencorp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: OpenCorp Legal <legal@opencorp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP next steps — SOC 2 evidence & retention windows

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited and we've started drafting a short MAP so procurement can begin legal review. Before we hand it to Legal, two outstanding items that will determine whether we can proceed on the quarter: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: can Redwood provide an artifact list and owners for the standard controls we flagged (logging, access reviews, vendor mgmt)? We need an ETA to share with our audit manager.

2) Data retention: Opencorp requires clarity on log retention vs. user content retention and whether EU residency / data residency options are supported. Our data security lead also wants to understand the minimum retention window you can commit to in the MAP (we're evaluating 90 vs 180 days for operational logs).

Finally, legal asked if you have a DPA with the standard EU addendum and whether you’re open to a couple of minor redlines. Can we get a consolidated answer this week so we can schedule a procurement sync?

Appreciate it — Laura

--
Laura Chen
Head of Platform Product, OpenCorp
laura.chen@opencorp.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP next steps — SOC 2 evidence & retention windows

Laura — thanks, and great question. High level answers below; I'll follow up with a short MAP spreadsheet that maps owners and delivery dates (attached).

- SOC 2 evidence: we can provide the artifact index and owners for the controls you flagged. Kimberly will lead the evidence intake and can commit to providing the initial package within 5 business days (control list + locations).
- Data retention: we support both 90 and 180 day retention windows for operational logs; audit logs and legal hold artifacts are kept for a longer tier and can be set to 180 days by default. For EU residency, Redwood offers private deployment options (VPC) and region-restricted storage on Dedicated; we can document residency options in the MAP.
- DPA redlines: we can accept a small set of minor redlines. Please send them to legal@redwoodinference.com — we generally turn around minor DPA edits within 3 business days.

Next steps: I attached 'MAP-v3.xlsx' with proposed owners, dates, and a gated acceptance column (SOC 2 evidence intake -> legal review -> production enablement). If that looks good, can we lock an internal procurement sync Tues at 10am PT?

Thanks — Mina

--
Mina Haddad

Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP next steps — SOC 2 evidence & retention windows

Laura / Mina — looped in some specifics so procurement has clarity.

SOC 2 evidence (deliverables & owners):
- Logging & Monitoring: evidence package = log retention policy, sample log extracts, alerting runbook (owner: Kimberly Park) — target delivery: 2027-09-06
- Access Reviews / IAM: access review reports + role inventory (owner: Hannah Schmitt) — target delivery: 2027-09-08
- Vendor Management / Subprocessors: subprocessors list + SOC 2 attestations we rely on (owner: Legal Ops) — target delivery: 2027-09-06

SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a gap table for CAIQ answers; we'll convert the relevant rows into a SIG-lite packet for your security team.

Retention windows (proposal):
- Operational logs (debug/metrics): default 90 days (can be extended to 180 at contract level)
- Audit/security logs (authn/authz events, retention for investigations): 180 days
- Customer content (user data): per-DPA + residency controls (default: 365 days unless otherwise requested)

If OpenCorp needs hard guarantees in the MAP for 90 vs 180 for specific buckets, we should mark that as an acceptance criterion and document the fallback (Dedicated/private option) in the MAP.

Attaching: MAP-v3.xlsx (owners and dates) and a SIG gap-row snapshot (link in drive).

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@opencorp.com>, OpenCorp Legal <legal@opencorp.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP next steps — SOC 2 evidence & retention windows

Thanks for the run-down. A couple of commercial / risk items I want to call out before we commit the MAP: 

- 90d vs 180d for operational logs: 90d as a default is fine for hosted customers, but we should not undercut our internal ability to investigate major incidents. If procurement pushes hard for 90d across the board, we'll include an explicit exception that audit logs are retained 180d.
- DPA redlines: I'm ok with minor, non-substantive edits, but need Legal to sign off on any addendum that changes data residency or introduces vendor escrow obligations.

Can we do the following compromise so we can close this by next week: 
1) Offer 90-day operational log retention in the MAP for the hosted path.
2) Commit to 180-day audit log retention and document this in the acceptance criteria.
3) Accept OpenCorp's DPA minor redlines; Legal to turnaround within 3 business days after we receive the redlines.

If agreed, Mina/Kimberly — update the MAP and attach DPA_redline_v2.docx for countersign. Also add the acceptance criteria lines and the HubSpot deal link. I'll approve the MAP for close once updated.

- Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference

Laura / Legal team — quick update with decisions and attachments (finalizing MAP).

Summary of decisions (to be captured in MAP-v3.xlsx and DPA_redline_v2.docx):
- Operational logs (hosted): default 90 days.
- Audit/security logs: 180 days (acceptance criterion).
- Customer content: documented per DPA; default 365 days unless contractual carveout.
- DPA: Redwood accepts the minor redlines submitted earlier; countersigned DPA route ready. Legal to finalize DocuSign envelope after your signature.

Action items: 
- Mina / Kimberly: update MAP spreadsheet with the acceptance criteria and attach the DPA_redline_v2.docx (done, attached).
- OpenCorp Legal: review the redlines and ping our legal@redwoodinference.com thread if any substantive questions (we aim 3 business day turnaround).
- Schedule: Proposed procurement sign-off meeting: Thu 2027-09-09 10:00am PT.

Links & attachments: MAP-v3.xlsx, DPA_redline_v2.docx, drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDefMAP

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Mina
